basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and lifelong Star Wars enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a software engineer, developing immersive experiences for VR platforms. Outside of work, I spend my time modding games, particularly those in the Star Wars and Pokémon universes. I'm a night owl, usually active online from 9 PM to 2 AM PST. Currently single, I enjoy discussing government policies, particularly those pertaining to technology and digital privacy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holding a degree in Computer Science from Oregon State University, I have a strong foundation in programming and game development. My expertise in modding games like Star Wars Battlefront and Pokémon stems from years of self-teaching and participating in online communities. I also stay updated with the latest in tech policy through various forums and news outlets.
